protocol_kind: Fixed follow-up execution of published author-selected configurations, after published outcomes and the earlier 65-label matrix were known; no independent blind discovery claim
reference_selection_source: WeightCode/scripts/e13/t11_scan.py CONDITIONS.addprim_jump.refs: rulegen_mixed_sparse19_sal=q3, rulegen_mixed_grad_full=q2; runner.py labels q{candidate.slot}, scanrefs.configs uses lr-major order

data.fit: Official rulegen_fit_set(addprim_jump,mixed): 2000 jump compositions plus 2000 old grammar commands, followed by the original 65 experience rows
data.official_labels_check: Verify every generated label against pinned SCAN tasks.txt; no externally collected new labels
data.final: Same published sealed 2568 new and 1000 old commands, read once for each fixed candidate; report overlap with grammar-generated training commands explicitly
data.subset: Additionally report pre-defined final-new subset excluding every generated training input and every unlabeled input probed by the published WSP program; this is an audit of existing public data, not a newly collected independent test

execution.loss: Full-batch mean cross-entropy over all non-IGNORE output tokens
execution.accumulation: Accumulate summed token CE divided by the fixed full-batch valid-token count; one Adam update after all microbatches. Mathematical objective equals upstream full-batch, but floating-point reduction order differs; no bit-exact GPU checkpoint reproduction claim.
execution.sparse_mask: At base, top floor(0.19*numel) entries of every tensor by absolute full-batch gradient, stable upstream argsort; mask fixed for all 300 updates
execution.parity: Before fitting, verify torch vs canonical NumPy logits on all 65 experience rows; verify accumulated vs dense loss/gradient on these rows to abs1e-4 and rel1e-3 for nontrivial entries
execution.checks: No model selection in this follow-up. Measure published check split after fitting as descriptive only; never reject or switch configuration based on final scores.
execution.resource_cap: Start after prior CPU matrix completes. At most 3 hours wall for both fits, four threads, 128-row microbatch. Save fixed step checkpoints every 50 steps, progress every10; failures/cap hits remain in output. No GPU jobs and no external publication.
execution.repeats: Seed0 is the published reference. No stochastic layers or minibatch sampling after load; duplicate optimizer seeds would repeat the same mathematical full-batch path. No claim of robustness across independently trained base checkpoints.

cost: Report fit wall/CPU, gradient steps, actual microbatch forward/backward rows, calibration/mask and check costs, selected changed entries, full model hashes. Published configuration discovery/search cost is external and excluded from this rerun; BP rerun cost is therefore not its total method-development cost.
interpretation: Both WSP and rule-to-data receive the same grammar knowledge. They use it differently: explicit weight compilation versus generated-label gradient fitting. No universal superiority is prespecified.
